_doc: ledger 0098 0.2.13 (the Mac's decisions 2026-11-24 / 25, relayed): tools/divided_road.py's spec. Stations are the G10's s on the BUILT line (a draft's data/centerline.local.json). lap.right.span: the right edge on the measured right curb (s 66-348); lap.left.span: the left edge on the median's near face (s 143-348, the divided stretch); taper_m: the raised-cosine eases outside both spans, all outside both pads' cut rows (48th_colorado v3193-v3216 ends before s 0; colorado_50th's v129 is at s ~388). far.span: the far carriageway's side piece, from the median nose (one station before the first island row, so the islands author finds its ROAD) to past grid_unclassified_96's mouth (its centreline at s ~348.4, 8 m wide). island.span: the islands' search span (the divided stretch); runs where the lidar reads no raised median are gaps. island.span starts one station after far.span. lamps: the 12 poles the DRAPP 2022 orthophoto reads on the stretch (the Mac 2026-11-24: west a w2 f h j p, east b g i k o, the median twin n; not c, z1, m (no arm read) nor nw / ne (north of E 50th, outside the zone)); zone_s_built_m covers the six draft posts 0.2.12 built here (lamps 0-5, s 57-330).
